history: Exact stored team identities and certified period outcomes only. Same-season, strictly prior calendar dates. All predictions and rating deltas for a date use state at the start of that date. Sum deltas after all predictions; reset ratings each season.
formula: a=10^((rating_home-rating_away)/400); d=(prior_league_draws+1)/(prior_league_games+2); nu=2*d/(1-d); denominator=a+1+nu*sqrt(a); pH=a/denominator,pA=1/denominator,pD=nu*sqrt(a)/denominator. Ehome=pH+0.5*pD. Daily rating delta=20*(observed_home_points-Ehome), opposite for away. Update on every prior game including burn-in. No tuning.
ml_rule: Confidence pH/(pH+pA); home >=0.75, away <=0.25; actual tie is push
threeway_rule: Maximum unconditional probability >=0.75; actual tie is DRAW
rationale: New outcome-rating architecture explicitly accounts for opponent strength and draw mass without the independent run-count assumption used by the frozen Poisson candidate. Conventional fixed Elo units are design constants; no search.
external: Closed unless development gate passes and a genuinely new future window is separately frozen. This run never opens external.
